map.上下文窗口占用是做什么的？: What does Context Window Usage do?
map.如何使用上下文窗口占用？: How do I use Context Window Usage?
map.上下文窗口占用适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Context Window Usage best for?
map.计算提示与回复对上下文窗口的占用。: Compute how much the prompt and reply occupy the context window.
map.占用率 = (系统提示 + 用户输入 + 预期回复) / 上下文窗口 × 100: Usage = (system prompt + user input + expected reply) / context window x 100%; remaining = window - used
map.规划对话时把预期回复长度一并计入，避免生成到一半撞上窗口上限被截断。长窗口模型虽: When planning a conversation, include the expected reply length, so generation is not truncated by hitting the window limit mid-way. Although long-window models advertise large sizes, attention cost grows with the square of length, and middle content is easily ignored (lost-in-the-middle), so longer is not always better.
map.占用 = 系统+对话+回复；占用率 = 已用/上限: Usage = system + conversation + reply; usage rate = used / limit
map.超出上限需截断或摘要历史。: Exceeding the limit requires truncating or summarizing history.
map.占用比=提示词 token + 生成 token / 窗口上限(如 4k/32k: Usage ratio = prompt tokens + generation tokens / window limit (e.g. 4k/32k/128k).
map.中英混排时中文按字或 subword 计，需以具体分词器为准估算。: For mixed Chinese-English text, Chinese is counted per character or subword; estimates must follow the specific tokenizer.
map.占用超 100% 将截断，长任务应预留生成空间并定期压缩历史。: Usage over 100% will be truncated; long tasks should reserve generation space and periodically compress history.
map.窗口 8k，提示 6k + 预计生成 2k = 8k 恰好满；若实际生成超 2k: Window 8k, prompt 6k + expected generation 2k = 8k exactly full; if actual generation exceeds 2k it overflows. Keep the prompt under 5k and leave 3k for generation.
map.为什么显示占用满了却还能聊？: Why can it still chat when usage shows full?
map.部分实现会滚动丢弃最早历史以维持窗口，表现为'能继续但忘了开头'；严格实现则直接: Some implementations scroll-drop the earliest history to maintain the window, appearing as 'can continue but forgot the beginning'; strict ones error out. Always reserve generation headroom in the usage ratio.
map.不同模型 token 数一样吗？: Do different models count the same number of tokens?
map.不同。同一段中文在 GPT/Claude/国产模型下 token 数差异明显，估: No. The same Chinese passage yields noticeably different token counts under GPT/Claude/domestic models; estimates are for reference only, exact values need the corresponding tokenizer.
